# NWAA124 Curated Source Index

Source directory used during curation:

`/Users/4482173/Documents/GitHub/cloneid_physicell_agent_codex/data/nwaa124_supplement_file`

## Files Reviewed

- `Supplementary data- Materials and Methods.docx`: density-dependent selection protocols, model fitting, carrying-capacity estimation, competition model, stochastic and spatial simulation details, assay methods.
- `Supplementary Figures and Tables revision_2nd.docx`: supplementary figure legends and supplementary tables, including growth-model fit, carrying-capacity fit, mixed-population dynamics legends, density-dependent cell-size support, and migration support.
- `Supplementary_Data_1.txt`, `Supplementary_Data_2.txt`, `Supplementary_Data_3.txt`: expression tables. These were inspected but not curated because this branch focuses on density-history-dependent growth versus fixed fitness.
- `Supplementary_Data_4.vcf`: variant table. Inspected for manifest completeness only; not curated for this density-history comparator.

## Extraction Policy

The curation used document text and table text only. It did not use OCR, image digitization, or figure-point reconstruction. When a figure legend or methods paragraph supports an inference without providing exact point-level values, the curated table records summary-level evidence and marks confidence accordingly.
